column2: Wireless Power. The Power Relay Mk1 (60 m), Power Converter and Power Feeder Mk1 are now unlocked in the build menu; this milestone advances the tech tier. Wireless nodes sharing an ID pool power with each other within range, with no cable between them.
column3: 无线电力。电力中继器（60 米）、电力转换器与供电杆现已在建造菜单中解锁；本里程碑提升科技层级。相同 ID 的无线节点在范围内共享同一电力回路，节点之间无需鐋设电缆。

column2: Wireless Power tier 2: the Power Relay Mk2 (120 m) and Power Feeder Mk2 (24 m) are now unlocked in the build menu.
column3: 无线电力 第 2 阶：电力中继器 Mk2（120 米）与供电杆 Mk2（24 米）现已在建造菜单中解锁。

column2: Unlocks the Power Transmission Tower: a 4800 m line-of-sight link that carries power across canyons. It also advances Wireless Power to tier 3 (Power Relay Mk3 at 160 m and Power Feeder Mk3 at 48 m, both unlocked by this tier).
column3: 解锁雷达塔：一条 4800 米的通视输电链路，可跨越峡谷输电。同时将无线电力提升至第 3 阶（电力中继器 Mk3，160 米，与供电杆 Mk3，48 米，均在本阶解锁）。

column2: An access point for the wireless grid. Wire it into a powered grid and it will share power with same-ID nodes within 60 m -- no cable between the nodes.
column3: 无线电网的接入点。接入通电的电网后，它会与 60 米范围内相同 ID 的节点共享电力，节点之间无需铺设电缆。

column2: An access point for the wireless grid. Wire it into a powered grid and it will share power with same-ID nodes over a wider range than Mk1 -- no cable between the nodes.
column3: 无线电网的接入点。接入通电的电网后，它会以比 Mk1 更大的范围与相同 ID 的节点共享电力，节点之间无需铺设电缆。

column3: 无线电网的接入点。接入通电的电网后，它会以最大范围与相同 ID 的节点共享电力，节点之间无需铺设电缆。

column2: Converts between the wired and the wireless grid. Once wired into a powered grid it supplies same-ID nodes within 48 m.
column3: 在「有线电网」与「无线电网」之间转换。接入通电的电网后，它会向 48 米范围内相同 ID 的节点供电。
